description: Google Search Console performance data — clicks, impressions, CTR and average position by day, query, page, geography, device and search appearance

gsc_daily.description: Headline performance per day. Complete — the only table safe to take totals from.

gsc_query_daily.description: Performance per search query per day. Truncated and anonymised by Google; will not sum to gsc_daily.

gsc_page_daily.description: Performance per landing URL per day

gsc_geo_device_daily.description: Country x device per day — how much search traffic is actually local

gsc_sites.description: Search Console properties visible to the authorized account, with permission level

common_queries.headline_trend: SELECT date, clicks, impressions, ROUND(ctr*100,2) AS ctr_pct, ROUND(position,1) AS position FROM gsc_daily WHERE site = ? ORDER BY date
common_queries.monthly_rollup: SELECT substr(date,1,7) AS month, SUM(clicks) clicks, SUM(impressions) impressions, ROUND(SUM(clicks)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(impressions),0)*100,2) ctr_pct FROM gsc_daily WHERE site = ? GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
common_queries.top_queries: SELECT query, SUM(clicks) clicks, SUM(impressions) impressions, ROUND(AVG(position),1) avg_position FROM gsc_query_daily WHERE site = ? AND date >= date('now','-28 day') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY clicks DESC LIMIT 50
common_queries.striking_distance: SELECT query, SUM(impressions) impressions, SUM(clicks) clicks, ROUND(AVG(position),1) avg_position FROM gsc_query_daily WHERE site = ? AND date >= date('now','-28 day') GROUP BY 1 HAVING avg_position BETWEEN 5 AND 20 AND impressions > 50 ORDER BY impressions DESC LIMIT 50
common_queries.top_pages: SELECT page, SUM(clicks) clicks, SUM(impressions) impressions, ROUND(AVG(position),1) avg_position FROM gsc_page_daily WHERE site = ? AND date >= date('now','-28 day') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY clicks DESC LIMIT 50
common_queries.local_share: SELECT country, SUM(clicks) clicks, ROUND(100.0*SUM(clicks)/(SELECT SUM(clicks) FROM gsc_geo_device_daily WHERE site = ?),1) pct FROM gsc_geo_device_daily WHERE site = ? GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY clicks DESC LIMIT 15
common_queries.device_split: SELECT device, SUM(clicks) clicks, SUM(impressions) impressions, ROUND(AVG(position),1) avg_position FROM gsc_geo_device_daily WHERE site = ? GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY clicks DESC
common_queries.query_coverage_gap: SELECT d.date, d.clicks AS total_clicks, COALESCE(q.clicks,0) AS attributed_clicks, d.clicks - COALESCE(q.clicks,0) AS anonymised FROM gsc_daily d LEFT JOIN (SELECT date, SUM(clicks) clicks FROM gsc_query_daily WHERE site = ? GROUP BY 1) q ON q.date = d.date WHERE d.site = ? ORDER BY d.date DESC LIMIT 30
common_queries.sync_status: SELECT site, report, search_type, watermark_date, last_run_at, last_row_count FROM sync_state ORDER BY site, report

notes.retention: Search Console exposes only the last 16 months and deletes older data permanently. This connector accumulates beyond that window; the API cannot backfill what was never synced.
notes.totals: Take totals from gsc_daily only. Dimensional tables are truncated and anonymised by Google and will not sum to it.
notes.freshness: Data finalises over roughly 48-72 hours. Incremental runs re-pull a 4-day trailing window and upsert. Today is never requested.
